info.title: PayPilot
info.description: AI-powered commerce agent backend for PayPal AI Hackathon.

get.description: Retrieve product catalogue with optional category and stock filtering.
Retrieve details for a specific product by SKU identifier.

post.description: Processes user intent, searches and filters catalogue, ranks candidates, and returns top explainable recommendations.
Formulates an authoritative purchase plan derived from catalogue product price. Requires explicit user approval before payment creation.

get.description: Retrieve purchase plan details by ID.

post.description: Transitions purchase plan to APPROVED status, enabling subsequent PayPal Sandbox checkout order creation.
Validates that the Purchase Plan is explicitly APPROVED and creates a PayPal Sandbox order using authoritative backend pricing.
Verifies the PayPal Order ID matches the internal Purchase Plan, executes capture via PayPal API, and returns verified payment details.

get.summary: Get Payment transaction by Purchase Plan ID
get.description: Retrieve payment record for a given purchase plan.

post.description: Processes a full or partial refund for a completed payment with authenticated ownership validation.

get.summary: Reconcile In-Flight or Pending Payments (Admin Only)
get.description: Administrative endpoint scanning for payments stuck in CAPTURE_PENDING or RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.

schema.title: Response Reconcile Payments Api Payments Reconciliation Report Get

post.description: Idempotent receiver with replay prevention for incoming asynchronous PayPal notifications.

schema.title: Response Paypal Webhook Api Payments Paypal Webhook Post

post.description: Processes user intent, plans workflow, executes registered tools, enforces policy rules, and returns conversational response with activity tracking.

post.summary: Approve Purchase Plan within Agent Session
post.description: Resumes paused agent execution upon explicit human approval, creating a PayPal Sandbox order.

schema.title: Response Agent Approve Purchase Api Agent  Session Id  Approve Post

post.summary: Deny Purchase Plan within Agent Session
post.description: Halts purchasing workflow when user denies purchase approval.

schema.title: Response Agent Deny Purchase Api Agent  Session Id  Deny Post
